agent.md:
You help run the client desk. Clients, deliverables, status reports, time entries and invoices live in this app. Use the desk screen for today's priorities, the deliverables board for status and deadlines, the clients list for accounts, and the invoices list for drafts.

To draft Friday status reports, start the friday-report run. To turn a client's billable CSV time into an invoice draft, pick the client and start build-invoice. To record an invoice as written, start write-invoice: it always asks for approval before saving.

Slack messages cannot be read in this app (only posted), so Friday reports are drafted from mail only. QuickBooks is not a connected service here, so write-invoice saves the approval locally; connect QuickBooks to push the invoice for real.
runs/build-invoice.yaml:
run: build-invoice
title: Roll CSV time into an invoice draft
budget:
  per_run: 0.05
params:
  client:
    type: ref
    to: client
  time:
    type: refs
    to: time_entry
    default: "billable:true"
steps:
  - id: draft
    title: Roll the time into an invoice body
    ai:
      prompt: "You are rolling billable time into an invoice draft for {{params.client.name}}. Using the billable time entries below, write an invoice body with one line per entry as 'date — description — hours' and finish with a Total hours line. Time entries: $params.time"
      output:
        type: object
        required: [body]
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          body:
            type: string
      example:
        body: "2026-06-15 — Design review — 6 hours. Total hours: 6."
  - id: save
    title: Save the invoice draft
    records.create:
      type: invoice
      set:
        name: "Invoice — {{params.client.name}}"
        client: $params.client.id
        body: $steps.draft.output.body
        status: Draft
runs/friday-report.yaml:
run: friday-report
title: Draft Friday client status reports
budget:
  per_run: 0.05
params:
  client:
    type: refs
    to: client
    default: "name:*"
steps:
  - id: per-client
    title: One report per client
    loop:
      over: $params.client
      as: client
      max: 50
    steps:
      - id: mail
        title: Search recent mail for the client
        tool: gmail.search
        args:
          q: "{{client.name}} newer_than:7d"
      - id: draft
        title: Draft the status report
        ai:
          prompt: "You are drafting a Friday client status report for {{client.name}}. Using the client recent email below, write a short status update with three sections: Progress, Blockers and Next week. Keep it factual and under 200 words. Slack is not connected, so base the update on email only. Recent email: $steps.mail.output"
          output:
            type: object
            required: [body]
            additionalProperties: false
            properties:
              body:
                type: string
          example:
            body: "Progress: final QA on the redesign. Blockers: none. Next week: launch checklist."
      - id: save
        title: Save the report as a draft
        records.create:
          type: report
          set:
            name: "Weekly status — {{client.name}}"
            client: $client.id
            body: $steps.draft.output.body
            status: Draft
runs/write-invoice.yaml:
run: write-invoice
title: Write an invoice, asking first
params:
  invoice:
    type: ref
    to: invoice
steps:
  - id: write
    title: Write the invoice (needs your approval)
    gate:
      approval: proof
    records.update:
      type: invoice
      id: $params.invoice.id
      set:
        status: Written
